title: logania × armstrongii
intro: Logania × armstrongii, commonly known as the hybrid logania, is a plant species resulting from the cross-breeding of Logania buxifolia and Logania coriacea. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Logania × armstrongii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and improve overall immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
